question: The Article 371A deals with the special provision with respect to which of the following states?
solution:
The correct answer is __Nagaland__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Article 371A__

 __
 
• It states that no act of Parliament would apply to the state of Nagaland in a matter relating to religion.
 
• Nagaland must pass a resolution for an act to be applicable to the state.
 
• The governor is given special responsibilities with respect to law and order in the state as well.
